horoscopes.horoscope: Decisions about career and finance will keep you preoccupied today. After a hectic day, all you may want to do is relax. In that case, Ganesha may send a short but pleasurable trip your way, which is sure to rejuvenate you. Group activity suggests you will make more friends, says Ganesha. You may remain very enthusiastic and will enjoy a fun-filled evening with your near and dear ones. Your cheerful spirit will attract your sweetheart. You will bring a smile on your partner’s face. In short, a positive day lies ahead for you. Today, you will remain in very good health. Your suggestions will help others and that will make you feel very good. As you will be in good mood and health, you will be able to complete many tasks that too very nicely. Ganesha feels that today you are going to remain very lucky for money matters. The day is such that if you want, you can mint money. This is an ideal day to launch your big projects. You will experience a phase of good luck today, feels Ganesha. You will try to begin work on new projects. The work will see a smooth progress post lunch. You are likely to share your opinions in the meeting. Your suggestions will be of great value to friends and colleagues.

This is not a day when you should be fooling around with your health. Do not take your health and fitness for granted, warns Ganesha You will be feeling lazy and listless all day long. Chances are that you could fall ill on account of carelessness. Both physical exertion as well as mental stress should b meticulously avoided. From sunset onwards you can rest easy. The period of care and caution will have passed. Personal life may remain almost uneventful, says Ganesha. You are likely to stay aloof. Your partner may raise the questions about being detached. Domestic routines may bore you. Singles are expected to spend the time alone. Committed couples may plan to bring excitement for the next day. Ganesha feels that it’s going to be very stressful day for you. Health wise, because this is not a good day, you will not be able to complete tasks on hand. You should not waste your time in useless things and should set your priority. The day doesn’t look good to Ganesha for your finances. You are likely to face problems on the financial front. You will feel that if you don’t find desired support from others, you may go bankrupt. You seem to be in a slightly different mood today. You may not wish to take up anything that you may not be able to handle. Equanimity will be seen in your actions. Professional work may seem slightly boring unless you explore new possibilities.

Today, the bond that you share with your friends will get stronger. You are also likely to fall in love. If you are already in a relationship, you will plan to validate your bond either through an engagement or marriage. If you are a student, this is a good phase for you. Along with love, you will also get good grades. You are also likely to take part in extra-curricular activities. You will want to focus on your partner’s desires and expectations. Adjustment is the key to maintaining a balance in your relationship. Things will go smoothly once you will understand your partner. You may want to create excitement but you will remain indecisive, feels Ganesha. You may get more and more involved in matters related to other people. However, you should not allow this to happen. You should use your communication skills to resolve these matters. At the same time, don’t speak very much as it could drain you. Ganesha suggest you not to let any opportunity go waste. Be serious because money is likely to come in today. Distant possibility of gains through business partner or life partner is foreseen. You may lack efficiency in your profession. Your senior authorities will not care about your efficiency. However, they will want effectiveness from you. You need to ensure both, suggests Ganesha. You have to keep a low profile for the day if you attend any meeting.

There is every possibility that today, you will be probing and prying about your future, predicts Ganesha. A visit to a well-known astrologer cannot be ruled out. Also, you are likely to consult a doctor. It is all due to your bad lifestyle and habits. You had better improve your lifestyle. As you are provided with a lot of responsibilities in the workplace, you may not be able to give much time to near and dear ones, feels Ganesha. Things will be comfortable once you are able to communicate with your sweetheart even in the difficult situation. It’s not a very good day from health point of view, feels Ganesha. You could get fever or cold. However, you should be flexible with people and situations. You should take rest as far as it is possible else you may get drained. Routine or recurring expenses may need to be curbed in order to keep your finances streamlined. Ganesha feels that this is not at all the right day to invest money in any good looking schemes. Today you are in a mood to start working on new projects, foresees Ganesha. Therefore, you will do your level best and put in lots of efforts in order to finish old projects. Your energetic and hard working spirits are expected to ensure good results.

Fortune smiles on but a few, and when it does, it can take you to places you have never even dreamt of. Today is an exceptional day, in the sense that Lady Luck is backing you in all earnestness. So go with the flow and take your chances. You will find, much to your delight, that success is easy to achieve when you are willing to work hard and have luck guiding you. Call it the Midas touch, but success is yours in everything you undertake, says Ganesha. Love life will be awesome. Surprises are on the cards. However, you should not expect more. Committed couples should remain happy. Singles will get the chance to fall in love, foresees Ganesha. It’s the right time to get married, feels Ganesha. Overall, a great time will come your way. Your health is going to be very good today, says Ganesha. You should do more exercise today to build your body and mind both. You should avoid over-eating. Having more fruits too will be very good. Make the most out of this day. Ganesha suggests you to avoid overspending today, as planetary positions are pointing towards huge expenses. If you wish to try your luck in another job or business, the day is favourable. Professionally a successful day is on the cards, feels Ganesha. You will succeed in getting work done from your staff. Your hard work will receive a lot of appreciation from your senior authorities. You will start thinking of taking up the new assignments.

Reflect on past glories and assemble the machinery for accomplishing more in the future. New relationships will mark the road to progress. You easy-going nature will help you get along famously with people. The long-term family planning will give you concern, foresees Ganesha. You may share the same thoughts with your loved one. It’s better to come up with effective solutions, suggests Ganesha. You need to understand your sweetheart and fill his/her heart with sweet words. You will require lot of rest today. Basically, your mind needs relaxation. Don’t apply too much logic to things. If you can’t take leave today or if you can’t leave office little early, at least listen to music to keep your strained nerves relaxed. This is ideal day to buy a new home-theater or TV which will add more value to your life and routine because you can enjoy movies or TV shows at home, with all the family members. You should take your career very seriously today. You need to understand the cause benefit analysis. Thinking pros and cons will help you decide confidently. It’s better to chalk out the plans and strategies accordingly to reach your goal, suggests Ganesha.

Today might be a good day to invest in that body armour you saw on the telly last night. At least find one that will shield you from being at the receiving end of your seniors and the daily grind of life. If you happen to be a job aspirant, be prepared to slog it out for your success. Put off auction bids and sealed tenders for a luckier day. Whatever it is that you do to turn your luck around, Ganesha advises you to take abundant precautions in all matters. A distinct probability of arguments will keep your relationship tensed. If you are in a long distance relationship, it’s time to make a call and express your love just to reassure your beloved, suggests Ganesha. You will have a high chance of developing a beautiful relationship, foresees Ganesha. You will be in good health today. You will be full of enthusiasm. You may face some rapid activities but that is not going to make you tired, feels Ganesha. It’s a good day also to enjoy outings. Activities will add to your energy. Some amount may be spent behind communication. This is by the way, a good day to spend money on new mobile or Tablet. Communication is the key to success, so investments done in that area should be worth. You tend to be inclined to people sharing similar interests with you. You need to enhance your memory power so as to solve complex problems effectively, suggests Ganesha. Important projects will get solved on time. You may express your views in the meeting.

House renovation is in the offing. You may furnish it with portraits and artefacts. Today, you may also feel like playing the stock market game and stake your bets, says Ganesha. Have a great time at home by hosting friends over. Your commitment will ultimately find success in love life. You do not need to hide your current relationship status. It’s the time to let your family know if you are in a serious relationship, suggests Ganesha. If romance falls short of your expectation, you will spice up your romance. You should avoid confronting others. It may eat up much of your energy unnecessarily, says Ganesha. If others do not believe what you are saying, let it be. Don’t try to change it. You should remain calm to maintain good health. Family members will find a boost in their regular income. Ganesha feels that if you remain united with your family, you as a family will enrich further. Stay in tune with family members and see the results. You will be looking at life from a different angle, as a desire for profit rules your mind today. You will be determined to achieve positive results. It will be routine work at the office without any obstacles, says Ganesha. You want to make sure that your office will get benefitted from your contribution.

Personal grooming will be on your mind today. A small fortune may be spent on enhancing the way you look, especially on a new hair-do. Retail Therapy is on the cards, and you may indulge spending on clothes and jewellery. It is an encouraging day on the personal front and you can expect a gift from your partner. You will get the emotional support from your partner. This is a lovely day if you are planning on enjoying genuine pleasure in making simple things extraordinary. It’ s a good day for you. Your sportsman-spirit will help you win many hearts. You will be at the best of your wit. You will feel and seem more relaxed and at ease. Ganesha feels that the day is going to pass very swiftly. Because your buying impulse is going to be very high today, you may end up spending money on credit cards. You may also take loans to buy things. Well, Ganesha wants to warn you against such expenses today. You will get rewarded for your hard work from your boss. You may want to spruce up and look presentable. You will be able to express your opinions honestly in the meeting. You need to avoid overdoing this as people may get the wrong impression.

It’s difficult to keep calm and have a control over your temper in times of distress, but today, you will prove all who surrendered to the whims of adversity wrong, foresees Ganesha. You will be unfaltering in dealing with problems, and will overcome them with ease. At home, you will be content and at peace, and this will also reflect in your work, adding to your already high efficiency. You may have the let go attitude today, foresees Ganesha. This will help you keep your emotional high tides in control. You may be busy in enjoying entertaining activities with your sweetheart. The relationship will go smoothly provided that you will talk sweetly with your partner. Today, you may need more privacy to think deeply about certain matters. Your mood will not be very good so ensure that in seclusion, you don’t start thinking negatively. Ganesha feels that you should avoid over-thinking and must socialize today to return to normal mood. This is ideal time to invest money in some spiritual course. If you learn to meditate or if you join some cult, it will help you go deeper within. This will teach you the value of life. Routine work may seem bored and intellectual stress will keep you worried, feels Ganesha. Decisions that you may take today will be practical but would not be the final solutions to problems. You are likely to finish off pending activities, feels Ganesha.

The day seems normal as you are unlikely to encounter unpleasant situations, says Ganesha. The high point of the day will be your consummate skill with which you will handle mundane tasks. Ganesha reminds you of the saying, “Success is one percent inspiration and 99% perspiration.”. You need to think seriously about your relationship. You may have to give your partner his or her space. Compromise with your partner will be the challenge. However, a better understanding between the two of you will keep you safe, suggests Ganesha. Sharing is important today. That is going to double the joy and fun. As you will be in a cheerful mood, Ganesha is not worried about anything else. On the whole, it’s a good day from health point of view. Think about money that you have on hand and then decide if you can afford to spend or not. If you meditate over the matter, it will be waste of time. Face the reality, take decision and move on! Achieving your goal will be the prime focus today. Your out-of-the-box thinking is expected to bring a fresh approach today. You will be in the mood of breaking new grounds. This will definitely enhance your value at work, feels Ganesha.

Fear is a part and parcel of life, and while it can not be eliminated, it can certainly be tamed, and that is what you will be doing today. All your suppressed audacity will be on full display, says Ganesha. An emotion filled day is on the cards foresees Ganesha. Your beloved will try his/her best to keep you in a good mood. With your partner, you may share your confusions and feelings which may help you take the right decision. Today your energy is going up and up so you should rather channelize it and use in proper direction, says Ganesha. You will remain focussed on your professional targets. The day looks very good. You may work for longer hours but won’t be tired. This is good time to talk about promotion or career change for better financial prospects. Stars are in your favour to build strong foundation of future finances. You should think about your career seriously now. It appears to be a lucky day for an interview. It’s also a good time to change your career. However, you should be very confident while making the ultimate choice. Take your decisions before it’s too late.
